embeds.title: Day 10 shipped — 2nd station + closest-unit auto-assign
embeds.description: Davenport East joins Central. Roster goes 4→6 units. The new **`assign <incident>`** verb auto-picks the closest available unit(s) by haversine — no unit slot needed, just call `assign i_205` and the right engines + ambulance roll from the right station.

fields.name: Build
fields.value: tsc clean · 93/93 tests · vite 11s · 531 KB gz

fields.name: Two stations
fields.value:
**Davenport Central** — E1 engine, L1 ladder, M1 ambulance, P1 patrol (4 units)
**Davenport East** — E2 engine, M2 ambulance (2 units)
9 personnel total. Each unit's homebase coord captured for the returnToLobby reset.

fields.name: `assign <incident>` verb
fields.value: No unit slot. Resolves the incident, then for each entry in `required_unit_classes` picks the closest available unit of that class (haversine, agency-blind, deterministic). Skips classes already covered by previously-dispatched units. Falls back to any-class closest for legacy single-unit incidents.

fields.name: Why this matters
fields.value: Tier 2's structure fire (`engine + ladder` required) is now `assign i_205` — keystroke speedrun. The picker prefers the same-station pair when available; only crosses to the other station when the local class is busy. **Tier 3 next-day will stress this hard.**

fields.name: Tests (+12)
fields.value: `pickClosestAvailable`: picks central for westside, east for eastside, respects excluded set, returns null when no match, any-class fallback. `assignClosest`: fans out across required classes, falls back to other station when first is busy, rejects when no available class unit, skips classes already covered on partial-fill, rejects already-resolved or pre-assigned single-unit incidents.
